stories.title: Central Railway Pays Homage to Martyrs of 26/11 Terror Attack at CSMT
stories.summary: Central Railway paid solemn tribute to the brave police officers, police personnel, railway staff and innocent passengers who lost their lives in the dastardly terrorist attack at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT) on November 26, 2008.

stories.title: Mumbai police deploy 500 personnel at Diljit Dosanjh concert after bomb threat
stories.summary: Mumbai police have deployed more than 500 personnel at Mahalaxmi Racecourse for actor-singer Diljit Dosanjh’s concert on Friday, November 27, following a threat email warning of possible attacks on the venue and Metro stations, officials said. Officials further said that Bomb Detection and Disposal Squad (BDDS) teams have also swept the venue, adding that entry checks will be carried out across all five gates instead of three, as per PTI.

stories.title: BMC clears 15-year deal with Raymond to turn Worli jetty into helipad
stories.summary: The BMC standing committee has cleared a 15-year public-private partnership (PPP) agreement with Raymond Ltd to convert a jetty built during the Mumbai Coastal Road project into a DGCA-licensed helipad at Worli. The proposal was cleared on Thursday. Located opposite Worli Dairy, the jetty was originally constructed as a temporary facility to transport construction material during the construction of the Coastal Road (South).

stories.title: Bomb threats trigger security checks across Mumbai and Navi Mumbai
stories.summary: Mumbai and Navi Mumbai were put on high alert on Thursday, November 26, after threat emails targeting civic headquarters, courts, Metro stations and singer-actor Diljit Dosanjh's upcoming concert triggered security checks across the two cities on the 18th anniversary of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks.

stories.title: Mumbai: Smoking dispute sparks attack on passenger aboard Kasara-CSMT slow local
stories.summary: In yet another attack in a moving suburban train , a middle-aged passenger was allegedly attacked in the eye by a few people after he objected to them smoking beedi onboard the Kasara-CSMT slow local train on Friday morning. The victim said that he was travelling towards CSMT in the luggage compartment, and he spotted a group of commuters smoking inside the running train, to which he objected.

stories.title: Thane: Kalwa police seize Rs 94.78 lakh contraband, one arrested
stories.summary: 78 lakh, in an operation near Parsik Circle on the Mumbra-Bhiwandi highway . Officials, while briefing about the operation, said that the container driver has been arrested, while police are searching for seven other accused allegedly involved in the smuggling network.

stories.title: Thane MACT awards Rs 1.1 crore to family of cop killed in 2022 road accident
stories.summary: 1 crore to the family of a 30-year-old police head constable who was killed after a trailer hit his motorcycle while he was on duty in November 2022. Tribunal Member R V Mohite directed the trailer owner and the vehicle's insurance company to jointly and severally pay the compensation, along with interest at 9 per cent per annum from the date of filing the claim petition.

stories.title: Western Railway plans Rs 98 crore Vande Bharat depot at Mumbai's Lower Parel, Dadar to get greater capacity to originate long-distance trains
stories.summary: The proposed facility will come up on around 55,000 square metres of land currently occupied by Central Railway's Store Depot. The project will be executed in two phases, with Rs 49 crore sanctioned for Phase I. The planned infrastructure includes two full-length pit lines, six stabling lines, two sick lines and one shunting neck.

stories.title: BMC to fine pigeon feeders ₹500 at Dadar, Mahim Chowpatty
stories.summary: For residents living around Dadar and Mahim Chowpatty, accumulated pigeon droppings, foul smells and concerns over unhygienic surroundings have become a persistent nuisance. After repeated complaints that open feeding has continued despite the closure of Dadar’s Kabutarkhana, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has now decided to station personnel at both locations to catch offenders and impose a ₹ 500 fine.

stories.title: Two arrested with charas worth ₹12.20 crore at Lokmanya Tilak Terminus in Mumbai
stories.summary: 20 crore from their possession at Lokmanya Tilak Terminus (LTT) during an operation conducted on the intervening night of November 24 and 25. A case was registered on November 25 under Sections 8(c), 20(c) and 29 of the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985.

stories.title: Not just Saurav Das: CJP’s Dipke, Ranka also face Mumbai Police lookout circulars
stories.summary: Mumbai, November 26, 2026: Mumbai Police has issued Lookout Circulars (LoCs) against Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke and co-convenors Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das in connection with an FIR registered over the party's allegedly unauthorised protest at Shivaji Park in Dadar on October 2, coinciding with Gandhi Jayanti.

stories.title: Mumbai weather: Mercury touches 35 deg C as city records moderate AQI of 118
stories.summary: Mumbai is likely to experience mainly clear skies on Friday, November 27, with warm and dry weather conditions expected across the city and its adjoining suburbs, according to the India Meteorological Department (IMD). No rainfall is forecast, and temperatures are expected to remain relatively comfortable during the early morning before rising through the day.

stories.title: Enforcement Directorate moves Bombay High Court challenging order rejecting its plea for custody of ‘fake doctor’ arrested in Rs 200-crore CSR money-laundering case
stories.summary: Enforcement Directorate (ED) has moved Bombay High Court challenging a special court’s order rejecting its plea seeking custody of alleged fake doctor Dharmendra Kumar arrested in a Rs 200-crore corporate social responsibility (CSR) money-laundering case. Kumar had originally been arrested by Mumbai Police in July in the cheating case and was in judicial custody.

stories.title: Central Railways Top Officials Skip 26/11 Memorial Tribute In Mumbai, Attend Constitution Day Events
stories.summary: Mumbai: On the 18th anniversary of the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks, Central Railway’s two senior-most officials in Mumbai skipped the memorial tribute at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), even as security personnel, railway union representatives and passengers gathered to honour the victims.

stories.title: Illegal Bangladeshi national held from Borivali
stories.summary: A 35-year-old Bangladeshi national; who was living illegally in Mumbai for the past 15 years, was arrested by Borivali Police. On Nov 13, police carried out an inspection at Borivali vegetable market where they apprehended Marion Chandra Rath. Initially, he tried to converse with the police team in broken Marathi but the police went through documents on his mobile phone and were able to confirm his nationality.

stories.title: Gold worth ₹20 crore stolen after gang of 4 intercepts vehicle in Navi Mumbai: Police
stories.summary: Gold ornaments worth ₹ 20 crore were allegedly stolen on Thane-Belapur Road in Maharashtra on Thursday night after four unidentified men intercepted a car carrying the valuables, smashed its windows with iron rods and assaulted its 55-year-old driver before fleeing. 45 pm in Shiravane, along the service road adjoining Thane-Belapur Road.

stories.title: Andheri police station gets new in-charge after duty allocation row
stories.summary: Two key personnel have been transferred out of Andheri police station following a controversy involving duty allocation, harassment allegations and a departmental inquiry. Two key personnel have been transferred out of Andheri police station following a controversy over duty allocation, harassment complaints, and a departmental inquiry. Senior Police Inspector Ajay Kulkarni has taken charge as the new station head.

stories.title: Mumbai water cut continues on Friday in parts of city, low-pressure supply
stories.summary: Water cuts and low-pressure supply will continue in parts of Mumbai on Friday as the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) carries out pipeline repair work between Powai and Sahar village. Supply disruption The Bandra East Terminus area in H-East ward will remain without water supply until 9 am on Friday, while several areas in S-ward, including Bhandup West, will receive water at low pressure.

stories.title: Mumbai Bomb Threat: Mayor Ritu Tawde, Civic Chief Ashwini Bhide, Amitabh Bachchan’s Jalsa And Diljit Dosanjh
stories.summary: The email, received at around 10 am, was written in Punjabi, Hindi and English. 11 pm on November 26 and a court at 3 pm the same day. The threat also mentioned an alleged drone attack on Amitabh Bachchan’s residence, Jalsa, between November 27 and December 31. Singer Diljit Dosanjh, who is scheduled to perform at Mumbai’s Mahalaxmi Racecourse on Friday, November 27, was also specifically named in the email.

stories.title: Mumbai runners and cyclists choked by worsening AQI
stories.summary: Mumbai runners and cyclists are lacing up and hitting the streets again as the monsoon and pre-winter heat give way to cooler mornings. But as the city’s air turns increasingly polluted , the joy and comfort of outdoor exercise comes with a hidden health risk. From breathlessness and throat irritation to declining stamina, fitness enthusiasts say worsening AQI levels are taking a toll on their workouts.

stories.title: Mumbai: CM Devendra Fadnavis Inaugurates Model Joint Sub-Registrar Office In Lower Parel; State Proposes Vertical Property Cards
stories.summary: Mumbai, November 27: Maharashtra's first pilot Model Joint Sub-Registrar Office, modelled on the lines of a Passport Seva Kendra, officially commenced operations at Mafatlal Tower in Lower Parel, Mumbai. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis inaugurated the facility by unveiling the plaque and cutting the ceremonial ribbon.

stories.title: 88-year-old father moves to old-age home; Bombay HC orders son to return gifted flat
stories.summary: The Bombay high court has cancelled a gift deed through which an 88-year-old father transferred his flat to his son. The court directed the couple to hand over the flat to the father within 15 days. If they fail to do so, they will be removed from the property with police help.

stories.title: Suspected JeM operative held in Vadodara; planned to attack IAF station, says ATS
stories.summary: The Gujarat Anti-Terrorist Squad (ATS) has arrested a suspected Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM) operative with an assault weapon and ammunition in Vadodara, foiling an alleged plot to attack the Indian Air Force (IAF) station in the city, officials said on Friday (November 27, 2026).

stories.title: Nestle India Faces ₹36.36 Lakh EPFO Demand, Decade-Old PF Dues Trigger Over ₹20 Lakh Penalty
stories.summary: 36 lakh from the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), including damages and penalties related to provident fund obligations for the period between 2012 and 2019. The company informed stock exchanges that the order was issued by the EPFO Regional Office in Mysuru under provisions of the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952.

stories.title: Union Cabinet clears delimitation bill
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet on Friday (November 27, 2026) approved the Constitution Amendment Bill that seeks to implement delimitation to increase the number of seats in the parliament and to provide women’s reservation in the increased parliamentary representation. A similar attempt by the government was rejected in the Lok Sabha during the Monsoon session in April.

stories.title: DMK sets conditions to support Delimitation Bill
stories.summary: In the Narendra Modi government’s fresh bid to pass the Delimitation Bills, the support of 22 Lok Sabha members from Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) is crucial to achieve the required two-third majority, which it had failed to get in the bill’s last outing in April. K. Stalin, on Friday (November 27, 2026) asserted that there would be no “compromise” with Tamil Nadu’s interests.

stories.title: 'Rs 11L chandelier, Rs 5.5L sofa': Delhi govt opens doors of 'Kejriwal's Sheesh Mahal'
stories.summary: 69 lakh. Public Works Department (PWD) minister Parvesh Verma had announced on Thursday that the media would be given access to the bungalow first, followed by public visits.

stories.title: "Light Deepam At Deepathoon Tomorrow": Supreme Court's Big Order Amid Row
stories.summary: T he Supreme Court declared that Executive authorities had wilfiully disobeyed the orders of the court over the failure to light the ceremonial Karthigai Deepam at the disputed stone pillar on Thirupparankundram hill. Hearing the contempt petitions on Friday (November 27, 2026), the court accused the authorities and the Board of Trustees of having acted “according to their political bosses”.

stories.title: ‘Don’t Waste Time Of Court’: SC Refuses Urgent Hearing On Plea Alleging Distorted Portrayal Of Ramayana In Ranbir Kapoor’s Film
stories.summary: New Delhi: The Supreme Court on Friday declined to entertain an urgent listing request in a petition challenging the portrayal of the Hindu epic Ramayana in a movie, observing that there was no reason for immediate judicial intervention as the film had already hit theatres.

stories.title: Naidu in Delhi for NDA meeting after Union Cabinet clears delimitation Bill with 50% rise in seats for all States
stories.summary: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu left for New Delhi on Friday (November 27, 2026) to attend a meeting of National Democratic Alliance (NDA) leaders convened by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, ahead of a special sitting of Parliament. Mr. Naidu flew to the national capital after chairing a State Cabinet meeting in Amaravati virtually.

stories.title: Setback To TMC Rebel Camp As Calcutta HC Quashes Ritabrata Banerjee's LoP Appointment
stories.summary: In a setback to the Trinamool Congress rebel camp, the Calcutta High Court on Friday set aside the appointment of Ritabrata Banerjee as the Leader of the Opposition (LoP) in the West Bengal Assembly and directed the Speaker to take a fresh decision within 10 days.

stories.title: Gujarat ATS foils JeM attack plot, arrests Assam man with AK-47 rifle targeting Vadodara Air Force Station
stories.summary: The Gujarat Anti-Terrorist Squad (ATS) on Friday arrested a 22-year-old man allegedly linked to Pakistan-based terror outfit Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM) for plotting an attack on a security establishment in the Vadodara district. An AK-47-type automatic assault rifle, two empty magazines, 23 live cartridges, a JeM flag, and approximately ₹ 20,000 in cash were recovered from his possession, officials added.

stories.title: Kitchen Items Costed ₹52.5 Lakh, Curtains Worth ₹30 Lakh: Kapil Mishra Gives Inside Tour Of Arvind Kejriwal’s ₹58 Cr ‘Sheesh Mahal’ | VIDEO
stories.summary: VIDEO | All Photos By ANI The controversy surrounding former Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal's official residence, popularly known as 'Sheesh Mahal', has resurfaced after the government opened his former official residence at 6, Flagstaff Road, to the media and the public on November 27, 2026.

stories.title: Shiv Sena issues whip to MPs ahead of Parliament's special session
stories.summary: The Shiv Sena has issued a whip directing its MPs to attend the special sitting of Parliament beginning November 30, the party's chief whip Shrirang Barne said on Friday, reported the PTI. Barne said all party MPs have been instructed to reach Delhi by the night of November 29.

stories.title: Centre authorises states, UTs to exercise powers under UAPA against Zakir Naik’s IRF
stories.summary: New Delhi, The Centre has authorised states and Union territories to exercise powers related to funds and premises under the stringent Unlawful Activities Act, 1967, in relation to fugitive preacher Zakir Naik's Islamic Research Foundation , which was declared an unlawful association earlier this month.

stories.title: Himachal BJP demands re-exam after Sikh youth barred from patwari exam over kara, kirpan
stories.summary: The Himachal Pradesh unit of the BJP on Friday (November 27, 2026) demanded a re-examination for the patwari post exclusively for an Amritdhari (baptised) Sikh candidate who was allegedly barred from appearing in the exam over his kara and kirpan .

stories.title: Odisha’s interest must be protected: BJD on delimitation bill
stories.summary: The Biju Janata Dal on Friday (November 27, 2026) said it would decide its stand on the amended delimitation bill in the Rajya Sabha after receiving complete information, asserting that Odisha’s interests would remain its sole priority in taking a call on the issue.

stories.title: Unlit Lamp, Contempt Notices: Supreme Court Pulls Up Tamil Nadu Officials Over Deepam Row
stories.summary: keveeyes New Delhi, Nov 27: The Supreme Court on Friday issued contempt of court notices to the Tamil Nadu Chief Secretary, the Director General of Police, officials of the Hindu Religious and Charitable Endowments (HR&CE) Department and other senior state authorities over the alleged wilful disobedience of its order permitting the lighting of the traditional Karthigai Deepam lamp…

stories.title: Shocking! Man Dies After Falling From 27th-Floor Hotel Rooftop In Vietnam, CCTV Footage Surfaces
stories.summary: A foreign national died after falling from the rooftop of a hotel in Nha Trang, Vietnam, on November 25. The incident, which occurred on Tran Phu Street in Khanh Hoa Province, was captured on CCTV cameras, with footage subsequently circulating on social media.

stories.title: Culture Wins the War for Talent: Harsh Mariwala at IMC’s ‘Beyond the Boardroom’
stories.summary: The IMC Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IMC), in association with the Chamber of Marathwada Industries and Agriculture (CMIA), organised the first session of their joint entrepreneurial series Beyond the Boardroom: Real Stories. Honest Leadership, featuring Harsh Mariwala, Chairman, Marico Limited. Sharing lessons from his entrepreneurial journey, Mariwala said that attracting and retaining talent is fundamental to business growth.

stories.title: ‘One community favoured’: Ex-CJI Gavai writes to President, alleges bias in collegium picks
stories.summary: Former Chief Justice of India Bhushan R Gavai has written to President Droupadi Murmu alleging that the Supreme Court collegium is increasingly favouring candidates from “one particular section of the society” for elevation to constitutional courts, to the exclusion of scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, other backward classes, minorities and women.

stories.title: Sukesh Chandrashekhar serves legal notice to Netflix over documentary Love, Scam aur Dhokha; says it presents one-sided narrative
stories.summary: Alleged conman Sukesh Chandrashekhar has served a legal notice to the makers of the upcoming documentary, Love, Scam aur Dhokha : The Sukesh Chandrashekhar Story, based on his life and alleged fraud case. Sukesh has alleged that the documentary, set to stream on Netflix, presents a one-sided narrative of his life and has sought a deferral of its release until his case is completed.

stories.title: Tripura Votes In Civic Body Polls Amid Tight Security, Counting On December 2
stories.summary: Polling is underway on Friday (November 27, 2026) for 16 urban local bodies, including the Agartala Municipal Corporation, in Tripura, amid tight security arrangements, an official said. 56 lakh voters are eligible to exercise their franchise to decide the fate of 733 candidates contesting 268 seats across the 16 civic bodies.

stories.title: Supreme Court’s ‘iron hand’ warning after Tamil Nadu’s defiance of lamp row order
stories.summary: By defying the Supreme Court’s one-time direction to also light the ceremonial Karthigai Deepam at a stone pillar , claimed by Hindu groups to be a Deepathoon, atop the Thirupparankundram hills, the Tamil Nadu government has disregarded a constitutional body’s authority. Believed to be Lord Murugan’s first abode, the hills have, for centuries , witnessed an intersection of religious faiths, with occasional skirmishes leading to tense flare-ups and legal battles.

stories.title: Pune court attack: Maharashtra Deputy CM Sunetra Pawar orders police to intensify action against criminals
stories.summary: Days after brutal Pune court attack, Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar on Friday directed the police in Pune district to strengthen preventive measures and intensify action against criminal gangs, illegal weapons and drug mafias. Pawar, who is also the Guardian Minister of Pune, issued the directions while reviewing the law and order situation in the western Maharashtra district.

stories.title: Chhattisgarh forest dept registers case against NMDC GM after Dantewada mining dump collapse
stories.summary: The Chhattisgarh forest department has registered a Preliminary Offence Report (POR) against a senior National Mineral Development Corporation (NMDC) official after a mining waste dump collapsed in Dantewada district on November 18, with a preliminary assessment indicating damage to 25-30 hectares of forest land, officials said on Friday.

stories.title: Tata Sons Governance Row: Tata Trusts File Caveat Before Charity Commissioner Ahead Of Bombay HC Hearing
stories.summary: The leadership and governance dispute within the Tata Group has intensified, with Tata Trusts filing a caveat before the Charity Commissioner following representations by trustees Vijay Singh and Venu Srinivasan seeking an urgent inquiry, CNBC-TV18 reported on Friday. The development comes ahead of a scheduled Bombay High Court hearing on a petition filed by Tata Trusts against Tata Sons and its chairman, N Chandrasekaran.

stories.title: War At Sea, Hunger On Land: Zelenskyy Warns Of Risks To Global Food Supplies
stories.summary: Kyiv [Ukraine], November 27: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on Friday raised concerns over disruptions to agricultural exports through the Black Sea region amid the ongoing war with Russia, warning that the impact extends far beyond the region and threatens food supplies to hundreds of millions of people across the world.

stories.title: Delhi Teen Found Dead In Faridabad Days Before 20th Birthday, Police Investigate All Angles
stories.summary: Faridabad, Nov 27: A 19-year-old man was found hanging by the neck at his mother's house here days before his birthday, with police on Friday saying an argument with his mother may have driven the youth to suspected suicide. On the other hand, a paternal uncle of the deceased has accused the mother and her current husband of murder, with police saying all angles are being investigated.

stories.title: Pune Court Attack: Shubham Chavan's Murder Over Land Dispute Led To Revenge Attack On Mandar Kiwale - Here's The Full Story
stories.summary: Two gunshots, a malfunctioning pistol and a frenzied attack with sickles outside a Pune court brought a two-year-old land dispute to a violent climax on Wednesday, shocking the city. But what began as a fight over a two-guntha plot in Katraj's Santosh Nagar eventually led to the murder of Shubham Chavan in 2025 and, months later, a carefully planned revenge attack on Mandar Kiwale.

stories.title: From ‘Modern Family’ to ‘Friends’: The best Thanksgiving episodes that you need to watch this holiday season
stories.summary: The Thanksgiving season is upon us, and while there may not be a lot of films focused on the holidays, there are many TV shows that happily explore family dynamics over a Thanksgiving dinner. From ‘Modern Family,' ‘Bewitched,' and 'Friends,' here is a list of some of the best episodes that you can binge-watch to get yourself in the mood for the holidays.

stories.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
stories.summary: Two Italian nationals have died after an Iranian strike on a facility in Kuwait, Italy's foreign ministry has said. The pair were technicians working for German arms manufacturing company Rheinmetall, the ministry added. Kuwait's defence ministry earlier said that four people - the two Italians, a Kuwaiti national and Pakistani national - had been injured from falling shrapnel after a number of drones from Iran were detected and intercepted.

stories.title: Two Italians killed in drone attack in Kuwait
stories.summary: A drone attack in Kuwait killed two Italian technicians working on an air defence system on Thursday (November 276, 2026), marking the first fatal strike in the Gulf state for months. Both Italy and Kuwait confirmed the deaths, blaming the attack on Iran. But Tehran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi insisted in calls to his Kuwaiti and Italian counterparts that it was not behind the deadly strike.

stories.title: Sheikh Hasina's planned return puts Bangladesh on edge - and India in a bind
stories.summary: India correspondent Published 9 hours ago Sheikh Hasina has repeatedly vowed to return to Bangladesh. Now the ousted prime minister has put a date on her homecoming - 16 December - and even outlined how she intends to make the journey. The government in Dhaka, which had previously dismissed the prospect, is taking her latest declaration more seriously.

stories.title: Donald Trump urges Vladimir Putin to end ‘military aggression’ in Europe
stories.summary: S. President Donald Trump said on Thursday (November 26, 2026) he had asked Vladimir Putin to "pull back all military aggression" against Europe, in a fresh shift in tone towards the Russian leader he called his friend just last week. Mr. Trump said he had requested Mr.

stories.title: Japan space agency unveils Chandrayaan-5 rover prototype ahead of 2028 lunar mission
stories.summary: The Japanese Space Agency, JAXA, has unveiled the prototype of the rover for the Chandrayaan-5/LUPEX (LUnar Polar EXploration) mission. The Chandrayaan-5/LuPEX mission is the fifth mission in the Chandrayaan series of lunar missions to study the lunar volatile materials, including lunar water, in the vicinity of a Permanently Shadowed Region in the lunar South pole.

stories.title: China Looms Large over Taiwan’s Municipal Vote
stories.summary: Taiwanese voters go to the polls on Saturday in closely watched local elections that will shape the fortunes of the ruling Democratic Progressive party (DPP) as it navigates an increasingly precarious set of relationships on the global stage. Saturday’s vote will choose mayors, council members and other local leaders across 22 districts.

stories.title: BSF Shoots Dead Pakistani Intruder Along India-Pakistan International Border Near Pathankot In Punjab
stories.summary: Jammu: Border Security Force (BSF) troops shot dead a Pakistani intruder along the International Border with Pakistan in Punjab on Friday, officials said. Let us know! 👂 What type of content would you like to see from us this year?

stories.summary: S. visa and green card sponsorship for most roles in its consulting business, its largest division with over 150,000 employees. stories.title: Woman fined ₹2,350 for crying on playground bench in Germany; locals ask, ‘Where is the humanity?’
stories.summary: Having a rough day, sitting alone on a bench, and trying to get through a good cry is something almost everyone has done at some point. Getting ticketed for it, though, sounds like a bad joke. The woman, known as Hana, told the German newspaper BILD that she had stopped at the bench while talking on the phone with her aunt.

stories.title: AirAsia delays staff salary payments to end of month, internal email shows
stories.summary: AirAsia has ‌told employees it will delay salary payments to the end of each month ​from November through March, according to an internal email seen by Reuters , as ⁠the airline takes measures to conserve cash and its Philippine unit cuts jobs.

stories.title: Big, fat Bihar wedding makes global headlines
stories.summary: The sheer scale of the ostentatious celebrations and feudal display of wealth and power, in the backdrop of the many criminal cases the MLA faces, became an irresistible story for the world media. BBC observed that “the extravagant wedding in Bihar, a state where one in every three citizens is counted as multidimensionally poor, has been dubbed ‘a royal wedding’ and become a huge talking point.”

stories.title: Myanmar says it will not fully comply with ICJ genocide orders
stories.summary: Myanmar's military-backed ‌President has said his administration will not comply with all ​measures ordered by the UN's top court, which last ⁠week ruled that the country's security forces had committed genocide against the Rohingya.

stories.title: Australia sanctions suspects in Iran-linked anti-Semitic attacks
stories.summary: google Add Al Jazeera on By Al Jazeera Staff , AFP and Reuters Published On 27 Nov 2026 27 Nov 2026 Australia has imposed sanctions on two men accused of orchestrating anti-Semitic arson attacks on behalf of Iran. Foreign Minister Penny Wong said in a statement on Friday that the “counterterrorism financing sanctions” targeted Zohair Hassib and Kazem Hamad.

stories.title: Jannik Sinner out of Australian Open 2027 due to knee injury
stories.summary: Jannik Sinner won't compete in the first Grand Slam tennis tournament of 2027 while he recovers from recent right knee surgery, Australian Open officials said on Thursday (November 26, 2026). “We've been in regular touch with Jannik's team and they've confirmed he won't be joining us for the AO in January following his recent surgery,” Tennis Australia chief executive Andrew Abdo said in a statement to The Associated Press .

stories.title: Nine injured, three critically, after Bangkok oil refinery explosion
stories.summary: Nine people have been injured after an explosion at an oil refinery in Bangkok, authorities have said. Three of them are in critical condition, according to news agency AFP, which said the local hospital had revised its earlier assessment of four. A fire broke out after the blast at the Phra Khanong facility run by energy giant Bangchak Corporation in the east of Thailand's capital at around 14:45 (07:45 GMT).

stories.title: 'I wouldn't be here today without you': Student's praise for man who stopped train attacker
stories.summary: A student who survived the Huntingdon train attack has met for the first time with the passenger she believes saved her life during the stabbings. Astrid told BBC News that Stephen Crean's decision to confront Anthony Williams gave her time to escape. "I owe him my life," she said.
